Synergy Assist

PowerPoint Lesson Builder

Paste a Synergy Assist lesson and create a structured PowerPoint draft.

Teacher review required. This creates a draft PowerPoint. Check accuracy, accessibility, copyright and suitability before classroom use. Do not paste pupil names, SEND details or confidential information.

1. Lesson details

Default is the agreed English/SEN background colour. All generated slide boxes follow this background choice.

Icons is the new default. Legacy keeps the previous simple slide style.

2. Paste Synergy Assist lesson

Expected headings: Title, Do Now, Do Now Review, Key Terms, Presentation, Objectives, I Do, We Do, You Do, Check Your Work, Exam Question, Improve Your Answer, Exit Ticket, Final Check.

3. Quick check

Review the populated sections. Edit any box if needed, then click Create PPTX at the top.
